verdict.rationale: Codex supports connecting to local/remote MCP servers and 'plugins to connect Codex to your team's tools and data' (e.g., Figma, browsers), which enables integrating third-party-built tools/agents into workflows via a shared MCP config across CLI/IDE/desktop. However, there's no evidence of a curated partner-app marketplace or formal ecosystem program for third-party agent apps—MCP is a general protocol, and the dedicated MCP server mode is even noted as deprecated in favor of an 'app server'.
